cards.name: 短語_伸長堅韌的虯鬚
cards.scene: Close-up of a green climbing vine on a stone wall stretching out its thin, strong, curly tendrils that grip tightly onto the wall; a small ladybug watching; the tendrils look tough and springy.

cards.name: 短語_蓋出堅固的大樓
cards.scene: Construction workers in helmets with a crane finishing a tall solid concrete building with thick steel beams; the building looks very strong and sturdy.

cards.name: 短語_創造神奇的故事
cards.scene: A child writing in a notebook at a desk, and from the page magical things fly out: a flying whale, a tiny castle on a cloud, sparkling stars.

cards.name: 短語_彩繪巨大的壁畫
cards.scene: Children on ladders painting a huge colorful mural of a forest and animals on a very long school wall, paint buckets and brushes.

cards.name: 情境_高大的城堡
cards.scene: A little boy standing proudly next to a tall castle he built from colorful toy blocks; the block castle is taller than the boy himself.

cards.name: 情境_溫暖的外套
cards.scene: On a cold winter day by the front door, a mother helps her child put on a thick puffy coat; the child looks warm and cozy; cold wind and falling leaves outside the open door.

cards.name: 情境_香甜的蛋糕
cards.scene: Children at a birthday party table eating slices of cream cake with forks, happy satisfied faces, a big strawberry cream cake in the middle.

cards.name: 情境_美麗的彩虹
cards.scene: After the rain, a girl sits by a window with crayons drawing a rainbow on paper, while a bright beautiful real rainbow shines in the sky outside.

cards.name: 短語_堅定不移的勇氣
cards.scene: A child rock climber on a tall climbing wall reaching for the next hold with a brave, determined face, safety rope attached, not looking scared.

cards.name: 短語_鍥而不捨的精神
cards.scene: A boy practicing riding a bicycle; he has fallen down several times (band-aids on knees) but gets up again with a determined smile to keep trying.

cards.name: 短語_一望無際的天空
cards.scene: A child lying on a grassy hill looking up at a huge open blue sky with a few small clouds that stretches endlessly to the horizon in every direction.

cards.name: 短語_不屈不撓的意志
cards.scene: A small sapling growing straight up through a crack in a rock, bending in strong wind and rain but not breaking; a little sun peeking through the clouds.

cards.name: 情境_全力以赴的選手
cards.scene: School sports day running race: a boy on the last lap sprinting with all his strength, teeth clenched, sweat flying, arms pumping; classmates cheering at the side.

cards.name: 情境_五顏六色的氣球
cards.scene: A birthday party room where the ceiling is full of many balloons in red, yellow, blue, green, purple and orange; children looking up happily.

cards.name: 情境_聚精會神的學生
cards.scene: A boy sitting at a desk doing homework, staring closely at his book and writing, totally focused; behind him his sister calls him with her hand by her mouth, but he does not notice.

cards.name: 情境_一望無際的大海
cards.scene: A family standing on a beach looking out at a vast blue ocean that stretches all the way to the horizon with no land in sight.
